profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta, TEKSystems
profile.jobTitle: Founder & Full Stack Developer at jrodonthebeat.com
profile.summary:
As a computer science student at the University of California, Santa Cruz, I have a strong foundation in programming languages, algorithms, audio engineering, game development, and software engineering. I am also passionate about exploring and applying new technologies, such as AI/LLMs.

Since June 2021, I have been interning as a full stack developer at Training Funding Partners, a company that provides grant management solutions for diverse industries. I have led the implementation of several sophisticated features for their proprietary ERP system, such as data security protocols, efficient data filtering algorithms, custom CSV reporting, and OpenAI's GPT-4 model integration. I have also supervised and managed the application's deployment on Microsoft Azure's cloud service and led DevOps operations. I have utilized various programming languages and frameworks, such as C# .NET 5.0, Entity Framework Core, SQL, and JavaScript, to build the backend and frontend of the system. I am proud to have contributed to the company's mission of helping clients optimize their grant funding and reporting processes, while also learning and growing as a developer.

I also do full stack and online marketing work for my personal website, where I distribute music, audio/video software. In the audio world, I have integrated OpenAI's GPT-4 model into a couple different projects. Utilizing prompt engineering to achieve responses from the model that can interface/manipulate the audio software. This workflow was also done in one of my audio visualizer projects, where I used GPT-4 to update the 3D audio reactive visuals. 
  
My work ethic, commitment, and gratitude are shaped by my background as the son of two Mexican immigrants who sacrificed everything for my future. I seize every opportunity to improve my skills, expand my knowledge, and advance my career. I am always curious and eager to challenge myself and to collaborate with others. My goal is to become an innovator in the field of computer science and the online world.

positions.title: Founder & Full Stack Developer at jrodonthebeat.com
positions.description:
As the Founder and Lead Developer, I've showcased my experiences in music production and software development. My work encompasses music, audio software, production, engineering, and audio visualization.

Custom Music Store: Engineered a simple e-commerce platform utilizing Stripe API for secure transactions, tailored specifically for selling my beats and audio software. Integrated SQL databases to manage product listings and user transactions seamlessly.

Audio Visualizer Project: Developed an interactive audio visualizer using Three.js, capable of reacting to any audio stream. This visualizer has gained licensing for DJ/VJ events, enhancing online music experiences and has been used by countless artists and producers. Utilizes OpenAI's GPT-4 model to generate new visuals or interpolate existing visuals. Utilizing prompt engineering with the shader code that is used to produce the visuals.

Marketing and Promotion: Marketed my offerings through strategic use of social media platforms like YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, a focus on online visibility and sales.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contributed to AI initiatives as part of an internal team of Meta Enterprises @ TEKsystems.

positions.title: Audio Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer in developing multiple audio plugins. Utilized advanced Digital Signal Processing (DSP)
techniques. Implemented real-time features such as LUFS, True Peak metering, distortion, stereo imaging,
FFT visualization, oscilloscopes, waveforms, RMS, BPM detection, and key detection, and granulators. Integrated OpenAI's GPT-4 model with prompt engineering in order to parse and use results to manipulate the plugins. Utilizes JUCE framework and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed version 4 of an industry-leading proprietary grant management reporting ERP system that
manages extensive data from diverse industries. Built under the direction of management.
● Software Development life cycle (SDLC): Managed the complete development of a specialized ERP system tailored for managing data from aerospace and healthcare sectors. Adhered to predefined business logic and requirements. This involved guiding the project from its initial concept through to its final deployment, focusing on user-friendly designs. Utilizing Agile methodologies with regular feedback from management and users.
● Led the implementation of sophisticated features including data security protocols, efficient data
filtering algorithms, custom CSV reporting, and the full stack development end of the system.
● Data Labeling and Data Management: Architected a relational database using Entity Framework Core, emphasizing data efficiency and integrity. Crafted custom solutions for file reporting, billing logic, data filtering, and issue identifications. Utilized advanced SQL functions, LINQ, EF migrations, custom indices, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), and sophisticated row/rank/windowed functions for dynamic and robust data handling.
● Utilized C# .NET 5.0, Entity Framework Core, SQL, and JavaScript among other programming
languages.
● Supervised and managed the application's deployment on Microsoft Azure’s cloud service and led
DevOps operations.
●  Leveraged NLP and prompt engineering skills through the integration of OpenAI's GPT-4, enhancing both the workflow of a specialized ERP system and the user experience. Context-aware data
input recommendations, elevating user efficiency and decision-making processes.

projects.title: 2D Stickfigure platform DEMO
projects.description: A demo passion project developed with Pygame and Pymunk (physics library), Python based modules. Uses basic stick figure animations and perlin noise generated level. Combination of purchased assets and hand drawn 2D assets. Raw implementation of texture management, sprite animation system. 2D camera, input handling.

projects.title: AI Wavetable Synthesizer (VST3)
projects.description: Developed a wavetable synthesizer that utilizes OpenAI GPT-4 to modulate parameters and generate new presets, using C++ and JUCE framework.
